verifications.claim: NASA's Artemis II mission launched on April 1, 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'blasted off from Florida on Wednesday evening... at 6:35 p.m. Eastern time.' (article dated 2026/04/01); R3: 'Launch date April 1, 2026, 22:35:12 UTC (6:35:12 p.m. EDT)'
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly confirm the exact launch date and time.

verifications.claim: NASA's Artemis II mission is the first crewed lunar flight in over 50 years.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'The last time astronauts traveled that far was Apollo 17, in December 1972.' 'After a brief 54-year intermission'; R2: 'For the first time in more than 50 years'; R3: 'first crewed flight beyond low Earth orbit since Apollo 17 in 1972.'
verifications.reasoning: Sources explicitly state it as the first crewed lunar mission since Apollo 17 over 50 years ago.

verifications.claim: NASA's Artemis II mission features a four-person crew.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'lifting four astronauts'; R2: 'crew of four astronauts'; R3: 'Crew size 4'; R5: 'Four astronauts'; etc.
verifications.reasoning: All sources consistently describe a crew of four.

verifications.claim: Commander of NASA's Artemis II mission is Reid Wiseman.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Reid Wiseman, the NASA astronaut who is the commander'; R3: 'commander Reid Wiseman'; etc.
verifications.reasoning: Directly named as commander across sources.

verifications.claim: Pilot of NASA's Artemis II mission is Victor Glover.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'Glover, who is his pilot'; R3: 'pilot Victor Glover'; R6: 'pilot Victor Glover'

verifications.claim: Mission Specialist of NASA's Artemis II mission is Christina Koch.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Christina Koch'; R2: 'Christina Koch, who is the first woman'; R3: 'mission specialist Christina Koch'

verifications.claim: Canadian Space Agency (CSA) Mission Specialist of NASA's Artemis II mission is Jeremy Hansen.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Mr. Hansen of the Canadian Space Agency'; R3: 'mission specialist Jeremy Hansen from the Canadian Astronaut Corps'; R4: 'CSA (Canadian Space Agency) astronaut Jeremy Hansen'
verifications.reasoning: Directly identified as CSA mission specialist.

verifications.claim: NASA's Artemis II mission is a 10-day mission orbiting the Moon.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: R1: '10-day mission'; R2: '10-day voyage around the moon'; R3: 'Crewed lunar flyby mission' (not orbit); R6: 'loop around it' 'not land on the moon or even go into lunar orbit'
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm ~10-day duration but describe as flyby/around the Moon, not orbiting it.

verifications.claim: NASA's Artemis II mission is to test the Orion spacecraft's life support systems before landing missions.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'check that the spacecraft can safely make the journey and keep its crew alive'; R4: 'test the Orion spacecraft’s life support systems for the first time with people'; R6: 'check out all of (Orion's) environmental control, life support systems'
verifications.reasoning: Directly supports testing life support for future missions.

verifications.claim: Victor Glover is the first Black astronaut to go to deep space.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Mr. Glover of NASA will be the first Black man to venture into deep space'; R2: 'first African American to go to the moon'; R3: 'Victor Glover (an African-American) became the first person of color'
verifications.reasoning: Explicitly stated as first Black/African-American/person of color in deep space/Moon mission.

verifications.claim: Christina Koch is the first woman to go to deep space.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Ms. Koch of NASA will be the first woman to do so [venture into deep space]'; R2: 'Christina Koch, who is the first woman to go to the moon'; R3: 'Christina Koch the first woman'
verifications.reasoning: Consistently identified as first woman in deep space/Moon mission.

verifications.claim: Jeremy Hansen is the first non-American to fly to the Moon.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Mr. Hansen of the Canadian Space Agency will be the first person on a moon mission who is not an American'; R3: 'Jeremy Hansen the first non-U.S. citizen'
verifications.reasoning: Directly stated as first non-American/non-U.S. on Moon mission.

verifications.label: CLEAR

verifications.label: CLEAR

verifications.claim: NASA's Artemis II crew were in a strict, two-week quarantine prior to launch
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'crew entered quarantine in Houston... March 18' (launch April 1 = ~14 days); R5: 'entered quarantine in Houston on March 18'; R7: 'in quarantine for the past week' (contextual, but aligns with ~2 weeks total)
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm quarantine starting ~2 weeks before launch on March 18; 'strict' is reasonably inferred as standard preflight protocol.
